description: Database Table Audit & Cleanup - Remove unused table definitions (forms, form_submissions, form_files, plugin_assets, log_config) from schema and migrations

userStories.title: Remove form system tables from schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the unused forms, form_submissions, and form_files table definitions so the schema only contains tables the app actually uses.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove forms, form_submissions, form_files table definitions from db/schema.ts
Remove all related type exports (InsertForm, SelectForm, etc.)
Remove any imports referencing these tables across src/
Grep confirms zero remaining references to these table names in src/
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Remove plugin_assets table from schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the unused plugin_assets table definition since no code queries or writes to it.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove plugin_assets table definition from db/schema.ts
Remove any related type exports
Remove any imports referencing plugin_assets across src/
Grep confirms zero remaining references to plugin_assets in src/
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Remove log_config table from schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the unused log_config table since it is defined but never queried in production code.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove log_config table definition from db/schema.ts
Remove any related type exports
Update or remove any test files that reference log_config
Grep confirms zero remaining references to log_config in src/
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Clean up migrations for removed tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove migration code that creates the deleted tables so migrations stay consistent with the schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove or update migration statements that CREATE TABLE for forms, form_submissions, form_files, plugin_assets, log_config
Remaining migrations still run without errors
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Verify clean state
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to confirm the schema only contains used tables and nothing is broken after cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: All remaining tables in db/schema.ts have at least one query reference in application code
npm run build passes
npx vitest --run passes with no new failures
npx knip --no-progress reports no new unused exports from schema removal
Typecheck passes
